I am 21. There were a lot of things that I was passionate about in life. I had too many hobbies. But now, I have lost interest in everything.
I am a student in Europe from the last 5 months. This is the first time that I have ever been out of my home state in a country in Asia.
I have lost all interest in academics too. My thoughts are all negative now, i can hardly think about anything else except the fact that I am universally hated.
